context_image.usage_description: The left 256x128 is the unchanged walking source. The right dressed sprite guides only the cream short-sleeve shirt and plain navy waistcoat, never its static body pose.

parameters.description: In each native 64x64 cell of this 4x2 south-facing walking sheet add only a fitted cream short-sleeve linen shirt and plain navy sailor waistcoat matching the right-side reference's palette, outline and pixel scale. Follow each torso and shoulder pose. Keep the carrying hand and protected forearms bare and visible. Preserve all protected head, face, scalp, hand, shorts, legs, feet, body proportions and transparency. Eight consistent clothing frames in original row-major order. No hair, weapon, emblem, loose garment, extra limb or background.
